fact: HAC decision N°016/HAC/P/2026 of 25 April 2026 bans in article 17 the broadcast of AI-manipulated content and deepfakes during the 31 May 2026 elections, with sanctions up to immediate suspension under article 21.
title: Élections 2026 en Guinée : la HAC encadre la couverture médiatique des médias privés
